weights: current main comparison old MIXED-L LR/StateMLP/XGB, trained on1200 queries; same weights as P0-A/B
analysis_scope: existing baseline-L100 VALIDATION pre-I/O states,1000 validation queries, cache misses only; NOT full multi-L evaluation, not an online latency experiment
input: 17 pre_io_state columns; no new query/index search; no retraining
comparison: identical rows/labels, raw-feature permutations shared across models
methods: 10 repeats of each single feature and jointly shuffled Global11/Candidate6/RankProgress/Distance/All17 groups; frozen original validation thresholds at retain-FNR budgets0.1% and1%
thresholds: reuse frozen p0_old_models_rerun/sift1m thresholds; do not recalibrate after permutation
metrics: AUC drop, logloss increase, fixed-threshold skip/FNR changes; shuffle SD is not a confidence interval
uncertainty: paired query bootstrap of averaged per-query logloss increase,1000 resamples; permutation still may form off-manifold states; no causal or retrained-necessity claim
coefficients: LR standardized coefficients only, not directly comparable with MLP/XGB scores; correlated features can share coefficients
scheduling: start only after expanded P0-B root COMPLETE plus released run.lock; all compute single-thread; no concurrent formal graph timing
